name: Zaldimar Wefhellt
summary: Upstairs at the Lion's Pride Inn, Zaldimar Wefhellt guides young mages through their first spells. When they outgrow his lessons, he sends them to Stormwind City for further training.

sections.title: The Mage in Goldshire
sections.body: Upstairs at the Lion's Pride Inn, Zaldimar Wefhellt teaches novice mages the first arts of arcane, fire, and frost. Once an apprentice outgrows those lessons, he sends them north to Stormwind's Mage Quarter. There, Jennea Cannon can teach them more.

faq.answer: At the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, Zaldimar Wefhellt teaches novice mages their first spells. He guides them toward further training in Stormwind City.

faq.q: Where can I find Zaldimar Wefhellt?
faq.answer: Zaldimar Wefhellt is on the second floor of the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, in the leftmost room at the top of the stairs.

faq.q: Where does Zaldimar send novice mages?
aliases: who does zaldimar send you to
faq.answer: After a mage learns the basics, Zaldimar sends them to Stormwind's Mage Quarter. There, they can speak with Jennea Cannon in the Wizard's Sanctum.

faq.q: Is Zaldimar related to any other mages?
faq.answer: No relatives of Zaldimar are known. He teaches at the Lion's Pride Inn.

angles.text: As a young human mage leaving Northshire Abbey, you first meet Zaldimar in the wider world. He teaches you early spells, then directs you to the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind.
At the Lion's Pride Inn, Zaldimar teaches Alliance spellcasters in Elwynn Forest. You can learn magic before traveling to Stormwind.
